findings.message: The simile 'suspendu tel un croissant de lune' (suspended like a crescent moon) is omitted in the adaptation. While the instructions state not to flag the omission of decorative effects, this specific imagery describes Indy's physical orientation/shape while suspended, which is relevant to his pose.
findings.source_quote: suspendu tel un croissant de lune à une corde qui lui meurtrissait le torse et les aisselles.

findings.message: The adaptation describes the light from the opening as 'très peu de lumière' (very little light), whereas the source uses a figurative simile 'ne fournissait pas plus de lumière qu'une étoile clignotante' (provided no more light than a twinkling star). The adaptation converts the simile into a concrete description of quantity, which is an acceptable paraphrase.
findings.source_quote: l’ouverture ne fournissait pas plus de lumière qu’une étoile clignotante.
